supersedes: approach_matrix.py, which averaged viability away and ranked a non-existent drug first

rows.name: NAD+ precursor (NMN / NR)
rows.note: available now; 153 registered trials incl. rare monogenic disease and an n=1 in Li-Fraumeni at NIH. NMN raised BubR1 abundance in vivo (North 2014). Targets DEGRADATION -- which is also the timed event that releases anaphase.

rows.name: Arimoclomol (heat-shock response amplifier)
rows.note: NEW. Amplifies HSF1/HSP70 to assist misfolded proteins. 12 trials incl. Phase 3 in ALS, and an OPEN EXPANDED-ACCESS programme for Niemann-Pick C (NCT04316637, status AVAILABLE, 13 US sites) -- a real route for an n-of-1. Targets FOLDING, so it does not touch the degradation clock. No evidence in BUB1B.

rows.name: 4-phenylbutyrate (chemical chaperone)
rows.note: NEW. Approved for urea cycle disorders in CHILDREN; trialled explicitly as a folding 'corrector' in cystic fibrosis (NCT02323100) and for a destabilising missense in MCAD deficiency (NCT06069375) -- the closest precedent in shape to N1002K. CAVEAT: 4-PBA is also a weak HDAC inhibitor, which collides with the K250/K668 argument.

rows.name: Combination: folding corrector + degradation modulator
rows.note: NEW. The CFTR precedent: single agents failed and the approved therapy is a corrector-plus-potentiator combination. Two obtainable drugs, two mechanisms, one variable. Untested together and the interaction is unknown.

rows.name: Cancer-risk stratification from the allele map
rows.note: not a drug; needs no new biology; the only output that is actionable this year.

rows.name: mTORC1 inhibition (sirolimus) / senolytics
rows.note: obtainable, but treats accrued damage and cannot prevent mis-segregation.

rows.name: Haematopoietic stem cell transplant
rows.note: NEW. Established in other chromosome-instability syndromes and genuinely obtainable, but it addresses marrow and leukaemia risk only -- MVA's characteristic tumours are solid -- at high morbidity.

rows.name: Readthrough (ataluren / aminoglycoside)
rows.note: class obtainable, but only 4 of 2,536 alleles qualify and this child's is not one.

rows.name: Partial proteasome inhibition
rows.note: NEW. Approved drugs exist and it is on-target for degradation -- and it is non-specific and severely toxic. Listed so it is visibly rejected, not omitted.

rows.name: HDAC inhibition
rows.note: obtainable, and argued against: K250 stabilises BubR1 while K668 destabilises it.

rows.name: Prime editing, ex vivo
rows.note: editing is in human trials; corrects blood, and MVA's tumours are solid.

rows.name: AAV gene replacement
rows.note: deliverable, but a constitutive source fills the anaphase trough -- a mechanism veto.

rows.name: trans-RNA translation initiation
rows.note: Nat Biotechnol, Nov 2025. Right variable, right layer, no human has received one.

rows.name: Trans-splicing (SMaRT)
rows.note: best mechanism fit and the only route to allele 1 -- and NO RTM for any gene has ever been given to a patient. Required efficiency 23-38% exceeds published RTMs.

rows.name: CRISPRa at the native promoter
rows.note: not deliverable to a child; the right EXPERIMENT for the dosage thesis.

rows.name: Pharmacological chaperone, pseudokinase pocket
rows.note: no molecule; not evaluable -- no structure of 766-1050 above 3.8 A.

rows.name: Checkpoint timing extension
rows.note: only idea reaching the 280 transcript-less alleles; mitotic drugs are cytotoxic.

rows.name: Splice-modulating ASO (TANGO)
rows.note: KILLED: non-canonical junction flux 0.00% vs SCN1A 4.55%.

rows.name: APC/C-Cdc20 inhibition
rows.note: arrests every mitosis.

rows.name: Neoantigen vaccine
rows.note: germline variant; it would target the patient.
